qualifications: The all-case goal remains open. Latest complete sweep measured 1,380 passes, 675 skips, 2,557 failures, 115 timeouts, and no crashes across 4,727. Focused outcomes do not establish a new full-suite total.

StatWatcher owns native polling resources independently of its absolute lexical path cache. Reused subscriptions return the same watcher and increment the listener reference limit. Public stop queues one next-tick event and releases polling ownership; unwatch removes the cache after no change listeners remain. Initial/present/missing polling states preserve prior successful metadata, suppress repeated same errors, and compare libuv stat fields rather than atime-only changes.

The initial stat request keeps work alive even when unreferenced; later polling follows watcher references and other referenced work. A direct Node comparison exposed the initial missing-file callback difference and the retained oracle verifies the fix. Zero interval follows the one-millisecond libuv rule and validation follows the unsigned 32-bit domain. Own enumerable option properties, including Symbols, are copied before listener validation.

One exact integer metadata authority derives the existing Number projection and the watch bigint projection. New intrinsic integer construction and native arithmetic boundaries route through shared JavaScript semantics. Stat presentation owns constructor facades and mode methods, partial timestamp Symbols, and lazy dates; rounding calls the captured shared VM operation. Loaded internal fs utilities retain their BigIntStats identity.

Six new Node oracles cover cache identity, reference counts and stop ordering, immutable/getter options and validation, missing/created stats and private timestamp symbols, unreferenced initial requests, exact bigint timestamp relations and callback errors across GC, and public constructor/prototype/coercion/date/mode override behavior. The initial bigint-date assertion was corrected to the actual Node oracle result before final qualification. Constructor reflection exposed the deprecated wrapper and was fixed before retaining evidence.

Stat presentation and polling ownership are separate modules. Exact metadata is the authority for both integer and floating projections; the older constructor stub was removed. No fixture identity, oracle backend, fabricated outcomes, or source/workload markers are used in production behavior.

Complete internal handle/Symbol mutation behavior, Temporal fields, ordinary stat prototype/bigint decorators, recursive watches and async iterator watches remain open, along with TLS, UDP, advanced IPC, Workers, HTTP2, and other API gaps.

Groups and measurements ran sequentially without overlapping compilation or additional guest checks. Frozen sibling hashes and exact source provenance are retained; compiled runner git metadata may identify the parent publication before the source commit.

All eight fixed-work fixtures and Richards are iteration diagnostics, one round with no matched production qualification or speed claim. Hardware instruction/cycle counters remain unavailable on this host (previous perf_event_open ENOENT); no substitutes. Empty-script samples retain actual wait4 RSS and alternating order.
